text:
anya: flagging a weird dup-charge case: truncated stream -> client requeue -> different shard -> external toolcall charged twice. ledger shows prov + final.
peter: can you paste the simple repro?
anya: steps: client streamed, server truncated (FIN) at ~720 tokens, client retried immediately (requeue logic), router sent retry to standby shard due to local overload, toolcall ran again. both charges show up.
li: our dedupe uses local shard cache keyed by (session, tool-hash). requeue to different shard loses that cache.
ledger-bot: INFO ledger: provisional(session=atlas-9,id=pc_x1,tokens=720)
ledger-bot: INFO ledger: confirmed(session=atlas-9,id=cc_y2,tokens=718)
ux: short-term UI: group provisional rows with same session into a collapsed cluster labeled "pending reconciliation" and add "Request ops review" CTA.
anya: would also like a console trace flag "route-on-retry" so support instantly sees why dedupe missed.
sre: infra options: (A) global dedupe index (heavy), (B) sticky-requeue routing window, (C) best-effort inter-shard probe. leaning C + B hybrid.
peter: hybrid plan: router emits X-Prev-Shard + server computed X-Dedupe-Id = HMAC(session||payload, org_salt). receiving shard: 1) check local cache; 2) if miss, fire nonblocking probe to PrevShard with 40ms deadline; 3) if DUP -> synthesize deduped response; else proceed. ledger writes provisional with dedupe_id if present.
li: important: dedupe_id must be salted per-org and not user-provided to avoid abuse. also ensure probes are toggleable and bounded to keep P99 intact.
ledger-bot: NOTE ledger: accepting optional dedupe_id on provisional writes for later reconciliation.
ux: UI: show small gray pill "provisional" + hover text "may be deduped after reconciliation". cluster duplicates by dedupe_id when present.
sre: rollout: canary 2% reconnects for 24h, watch metric provisional_minus_confirmed_by_route. alert if regression or P99 impact.
anya: I'll open INF-12009 with traces and include an e2e that simulates truncated FIN + immediate requeue to alternate shard to validate dedupe. tagging billing, routing, and ui.
peter: one more: add telemetry tag on router events when route changed on retry to make dashboards queryable.
anya: thanks — P2. will coordinate follow-ups.
